UPDATE t_commerce_order SET version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE order_id=#{order.orderId} AND version=#{order.version} AND order_status='OPEN' AND termination_requested_at IS NULL AND paid_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_checkout_session s WHERE s.checkout_session_id=#{session.checkoutSessionId} AND s.order_id=#{order.orderId} AND s.version=#{session.version} AND s.session_status IN ('PREPARING','OPEN')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_consumer_contract c WHERE c.consumer_contract_id=#{contractId} AND c.order_id=#{order.orderId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_order_payment_projection p WHERE p.order_id=#{order.orderId} AND p.payment_intent_id=#{payment.paymentIntentId} AND p.version=#{payment.version} AND p.successful_attempt_id IS NULL AND p.captured_amount=0 AND p.intent_status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED'))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_order_payment_projection p WHERE p.order_id=#{order.orderId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_consumer_context c WHERE c.order_id=#{order.orderId})
